label: Plan and Roadmap reviews are back above the Deck

sections.title: Reviews you can always reach
items: Plan approvals and Roadmap drafts are back where you can see them. When the `Deck` arrived, a review waiting for you could slip underneath it, leaving your message box locked with nothing to click. `Plan approval required` and `Roadmap draft` now sit right above the `Deck`, so `Approve`, `Feedback` and `Create phase` are always in reach, and an open review takes half the window so your conversation stays in view. Update progress and `Retry Roadmap review` stay on top too.
